verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own plugin system. Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the instance [docs-3, docs-66, docs-26], and Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines run custom Python on your own server [docs-25]. Separately, a skill is a documented folder containing a SKILL.md file, and Computer picks up local skills automatically [docs-11, docs-57]. Missing for 10: the excerpts do not show the concrete plugin interface or the step-by-step loading/import workflow, and there is no independent hands-on report of a developer authoring and loading a custom plugin.
